answer: The linchpin is Coachbuilder ash spoke mark sworn before the tyre forge bench: remove it and the farm walks in; keep it and the farm pays each ash spoke is an iron tyre pressed beside the wheelwrights mark, so a farm must per alias. Time is the tax: 14 minutes for one agent, 7756 minutes for 554 fakes, charged every epoch without fail. The mirror proves one person, the prism prices one forgery, and the dawn remembers one epoch after another. One seat, one proof, one price: the farm cannot buy in bulk.
